analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-buffer-overflow due to missing bounds validation before fetching the next line-program opcode byte. In read_line_table_program(), the loop condition only checks line_ptr < line_ptr_end, but line_ptr_end is derived from line table metadata and can exceed the actual mapped .debug_line section buffer for malformed input. The code then unconditionally does `opcode = *line_ptr` (line ~1370), causing an OOB read past the allocated section data.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The fuzzed ELF provides corrupted DWARF line table/header values (via dwarf_srclines_b -> _dwarf_internal_srclines) such that parsed line table bounds (especially lc_line_ptr_end / table offsets) are inconsistent with real section allocation size from elf_load_nolibelf_section. read_line_table_program is then invoked with a too-large end pointer, and while decoding opcodes it advances line_ptr until it reads beyond the heap allocation, triggering ASan.
